notes: API-backed icon atom. Fetches SVG from Asset Library Worker at build/render time. Weight resolved via brand config or explicit override. All SVG transforms (stroke, gradient, draw, morph) happen server-side before inlining. textonly: null — decorative, skipped entirely.

name.description: Icon base name or full slug (e.g. 'heart' or 'heart-fill'). Folder prefixes and ph: prefix stripped automatically.

weight.description: Override weight. Defaults to brand config (ICON_WEIGHT env var, usually 'fill').

semanticRole.description: Semantic role for assistive tech. Decorative icons get aria-hidden. Content-symbol icons participate in AAC display.

size.description: Icon size in pixels. Sets width and height on wrapper span.

color.description: CSS color value or variable. Skipped when gradient is set.

gradient.description: Gradient fill injected as SVG linearGradient. Mutually exclusive with color.

stroke.description: Line-art mode. Strips fills and adds stroke to all shapes.

class.description: Additional CSS classes on wrapper span.

animation._description: Motion behaviour — gated by prop-driven classes (no prop = no class = no motion)

pulse.description: Scale pulse on hover for attention.

draw.description: DrawSVG animation. Converts fills to strokes for path drawing effect.

drawOnScroll.description: Trigger draw animation on scroll into view.

drawScrub.description: Scrub draw animation with scroll position.

morphTo.description: Target icon name for MorphSVG on hover. Fetches target SVG from API.

morphColor.description: Fill colour for morph target state.

colour._description: Pipeline colour tokens — set as inline styles. 'auto' = pipeline resolves from context.
